name: boundary-model
description: Map a system's boundaries as its consumers see them, keep the map reviewed and current, and plan changes from shape to GitHub issues.

interface.longDescription: Nine skills built around one boundary model: who uses a system, for what, and through which interfaces, kept apart from how it is built. Extract a boundary map from a repository, review it with a person, bring it up to date after changes land, and draw it as a page or as still images. Shape a change as the boundary changes it leads to, compare ways to slice it, settle its details, and publish GitHub issues that each carry a proof of done. The map scripts need Node 18 or later, still images need Chrome, Chromium or Edge, and publishing issues needs access to GitHub.
